scripts.test: node --check server.js && node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/uniget-extension.user.js && node --check web-extension/background.js && node --check web-extension/content.js && node tests/api-smoke.test.js
scripts.pack:extension:firefox: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$tmp = Join-Path '.tmp' 'firefox-extension'; if (Test-Path $tmp) { Remove-Item $tmp -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $tmp | Out-Null; Copy-Item 'web-extension\*' $tmp -Recurse; $manifestPath = Join-Path $tmp 'manifest.json'; $manifest = Get-Content $manifestPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $manifest.background | Add-Member -NotePropertyName scripts -NotePropertyValue @('background.js') -Force; $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | Set-Content $manifestPath -Encoding UTF8; if (Test-Path 'UniGet-Firefox-Extension-v1.5.12.zip') { Remove-Item 'UniGet-Firefox-Extension-v1.5.12.zip' -Force }; Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $tmp '*') -DestinationPath 'UniGet-Firefox-Extension-v1.5.12.zip' -Force"
